spans.s: बहल (I) a. (f. ला) 1. Much, abundant, manifold, Sis.ix.8; 2. dense, thick; 3. hard, firm, compact.
बहल (II) m. A kind of sugarcane.
बहल (I) a. (f. ला) 1. Much, abundant, manifold, Sis.ix.8; 2. dense, thick; 3. hard, firm, compact.
बहल-गंध n. a species of sandal.
बहिस् ind. 1. Out of doors, on the outside, झटिति प्रविश गेहं मा बहिस्तिष्ठ कांते Sr.
; 2. out, outside, (with an abl.), निवसन्नावसथे पुराद्बहिः R.viii.15.(बहिर्गम् or बहिर्यां ‘to go out’; बहिष्कृ ‘to place outside the caste’ i.e. to excommunicate.’)
बहिरुपाधि m. any outward attribute, an external circumstance, Ut.vi.
बहिश्चर a. external, outward, D.K.
बहिर्द्वार n. an outer door, a portal.

बहु (I) a. (f. हु or ह्वी; compar. भूयस्; super. भूयिष्ठ) 1. Much, abundant, great, अल्पस्य ह्बेतोर्बहु हातुमिच्छन् R.ii.47, M.i.40; 2. many, numerous, M.iii.77; 3. frequent, repeated; 4. great, large.

बहु (II) ind. 1. Much, exceedingly, greatly, in a high degree; 2. very nearly, almost, e.g. बहुतृणम्.(बहु मन् ‘to value, to prize, to esteem highly,’ अस्माकमुक्तं बहु मन्यसे चेत् Bt.iii.53, बहु मन्येत राघवम् Bt.v.84, R.xii.89, Bg.ii.35.)
बाहु (I) m. 1. The arm, युवा युगव्यायतबाहुरंसलः R.iii.34, M.iv.77; 2. the fore-arm; 3. the fore-foot of an animal; 4. a door-post; 5. the base of a right-angled triangle (in geometry).
बाहु (II) m. du. The constellation Ārdrā.

बहु (I) a. (f. हु or ह्वी; compar. भूयस्; super. भूयिष्ठ) 1. Much, abundant, great, अल्पस्य ह्बेतोर्बहु हातुमिच्छन् R.ii.47, M.i.40; 2. many, numerous, M.iii.77; 3. frequent, repeated; 4. great, large.
बहु-अक्षर a. many-syllabled (as a word).
बहु-अच, -अच्क a. having several vowels (in gram.).
बहु-अच, -अच्क a. having several vowels (in gram.).
बहु-अप्, -अप a. watery.
बहु-अप्, -अप a. watery.
बहु-अपत्य m. 1. a hog; 2. a mouse.
बहु-अपत्या f. a cow which has had many calves.
बहु-अर्थ a. 1. having many meanings; 2. having many objects.
बहु-आशिन् a. voracious, gluttonous.
बहु-उदक m. a religious mendicant who lives in a strange place and subsists on alms.
बहु-ऋच् f. a term applied to the Ṛgveda, M.iii.145.
बहु-एनस् a. very sinful.
बहु-कर (I) a. diligent, industrious, laborious.
बहु-कर (II) m. 1. a cleaner, a sweeper; 2. a camel.
बहु-करी f. a broom.
बहु-कालम् ind. for a long time.
बहु-कालीन a. of long standing, old.
बहु-कूर्च m. a kind of cocoa-nut.
बहु-गंधदा f. musk.
बहु-गंधा f. 1. a bud of the champaka tree; 2. the yūthikā creeper.
बहु-गुण a. 1. composed of many threads; 2. manifold, multifarious; 3. having many virtues.
बहु-जल्प a. talkative, loquacious.
बहु-ज्ञ a. knowing much, having great knowledge.
बहु-तंत्रीक a. many-stringed.
बहु-तिथ a. very much, abundant, काले गते बहुतिथे Sak.v.
बहु-तृण n. anything much like grass, anything insignificant or unimportant, निदर्शनमसाराणां लघुर्बहुतृणं नरः Sis.ii.50.
बहु-त्व n. 1. abundance, muchness; 2. plurality.
बहु-त्वक्क, -त्वच् m. a kind of birch tree.
बहु-त्वक्क, -त्वच् m. a kind of birch tree.
बहु-दक्षिण a. accompanied with many fees, liberal.
बहु-दायिन् a. liberal, magnificent.
बहु-दुग्ध m. wheat.
बहु-दुग्धा f. a cow yielding much milk.
बहु-दोष a. 1. having many faults; 2. full of dangers, बहुदोषां हि शर्वरी Mrich.i.
बहु-धन a. rich, wealthy.
बहु-धा ind. 1. variously, multifariously, ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतम् Bg.xiii.4; 2. in different forms, Bg.ix.15; 3. repeatedly; 4. in different directions.
बहु-धार n. the thunderbolt of Indra.
बहु-धेनुक n. a multitude of milch cows.
बहु-नाद m. a conchshell.
बहु-पत्र (I) m. an onion.
बहु-पत्र (II) n. talc.
बहु-पत्री f. the holy basil.
बहु-पद्, -पाद्, -पाद m. the Indian fig tree.
बहु-पद्, -पाद्, -पाद m. the Indian fig tree.
बहु-पद्, -पाद्, -पाद m. the Indian fig tree.
बहु-पुष्प m. 1. the coral tree; 2. the nimba tree.
बहु-प्रकार a. of many kinds.
बहु-प्रज्ञ (I) a. having many children.
बहु-प्रज्ञ (II) m. 1. a hog; 2. the munjā grass.
बहु-प्रतिज्ञ a. comprising many counts (in law).
बहु-प्रद m. an exceedingly liberal man.
बहु-प्रसू f. a mother of many children.
बहु-प्रेयसी a. having many dear ones.
बहु-फल m. the Kadamba tree.
बहु-बल m. a lion.
बाहु-बल n. strength of arm.
बहु-भाग्य a. very fortunate.
बहु-भाषिन् a. garrulous, loquacious.
बहु-मंजरी f. the holy basil.
बहु-मत a. esteemed, prized, valued.
बहु-मति f. value, estimation.
बहु-मल n. lead.
बहु-मान (I) m. high esteem, great regard, अथवा सद्वस्तुपुरुषबहुमानात् Vikr.i., or वर्तमानकवेः कालिदासस्य कृतौ किंकृतो बहुमानः Mal.i., K.S.v.31.
बहु-मान (II) n. a gift made by a superior to an inferior.
बहु-मान्य a. estimable.
बहु-माय a. artful, treacherous.
बहु-मार्गी f. a place where many roads meet.
बहु-मूत्र a. afflicted with diabetes.
बहु-मूर्धन् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
बहु-मूल्य a. highly prized, costly.
बहु-मृग a. abounding in deer.
बहु-रत्न a. rich in gems.
बहु-रूप (I) a. 1. many-formed, M.i.49; 2. variegated, many-hued.
बहु-रूप (II) m. 1. a lizard; 2. hair; 3. the sun; 4. an epithet of Brahman (m.); 5. of Viṣṇu; 6. of Śiva; 7. of the god of love.
बहु-रेतस् m. an epithet of Brahman (m.).
बहु-रोमन् m. a sheep.
बहु-लवण n. a soil impregnated with salt.
बहु-वचन n. the plural number (in gram.).
बहु-वर्ण a. many-coloured.
बहु-वार्षिक a. lasting many years.
बहु-विघ्न a. attended with many difficulties or dangers, बहुविध्नो मुहूर्तोऽयं जीवेदपि कदाचन K.Pr.iv.
बहु-विधि a. of many kinds, diverse, multiform, Bg.iv.32.
बहु-वीज, -बीज n. the custard-apple.
बहु-वीज, -बीज n. the custard-apple.
बहु-व्रीहि (I) a. possessing much rice.

बहु-व्रीहि (II) m. one of the four classes of compounds; in it, the last member loses independence and together with the other members serves to qualify an altogether different word; it is either a noun or an adjecctive, but in its original, character of qualifying another word, it is always an adjective; the word बहुव्रीहि itself is an example, तत्पुरुष कर्मधारय येणाहं स्यां बहुव्रीहिः Ud.
बहु-शत्रु m. a sparrow.
बहु-शल्य m. a variety of the Khadira tree.
बहु-शस् ind. 1. frequently, repeatedly, गुणकृत्ये बहुशो (v.l.) नियोजिता K.S.iv.15; 2. generally, commonly; 3. plentifully, numerously, पश्यंतीनां न खलु बहुशो न स्थलीदेवतानाम् Megh./ii.43.
बहु-शृंग m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
बहु-श्रुत a. 1. very learned; 2. well-versed in the Vedas, M.iv.135.
बहु-संतति m. a kind of bamboo.
बहु-सार (I) a. possessing much pith, substantial.
बहु-सार (II) m. the Khadira tree.
बहु-सू f. 1. a mother of many children; 2. a sow.
बहु-सूति f. 1. a mother of many children; 2. a cow that often calves.
बहु-स्वन m. an owl.(किं बहुना means ‘to be brief, in short.’)
बहुक m. 1. The sun; 2. the Arka plant; 3. a crab; 4. a kind of gallinule.
बाहुक m. 1. A monkey; 2. a name assumed by Nala after his transformation into a dwarf.

बहुल (I) a. (f. ला; compar. बंहीयस्; super. बंहिष्ठ) 1. Thick, dense, compact; 2. ample, large, capacious; 3. abundant, much, many, numerous; 4. born under the Pleiades; 5. black; 6. full of, क्रियाविशेषबहुलां भोगैश्वर्यगतिं प्रति Bg.ii.43; 7. accompanied by.
बहुल (II) m. 1. The dark half of a month, बहुलेऽपि गते निशाकरस्तनुतां दुःखमनंग मोक्ष्यति K.S.iv.13, vii.8; 2. an epithet of fire.

बहुल (III) n. 1. The sky; 2. white pepper.(बहुलीभू ‘to get abroad, to be published, to become public,’ बहुलीभूतोऽयमर्थः Sak.vi., पौरेषु सोऽहं बहुलीभवंतम (अवर्णम्) R.xiv.38; बहुलीकृ 1. to make public, to divulge; 2. to increase, to aggrandize; 3. to thresh, to winnow.)

बहुल (I) a. (f. ला; compar. बंहीयस्; super. बंहिष्ठ) 1. Thick, dense, compact; 2. ample, large, capacious; 3. abundant, much, many, numerous; 4. born under the Pleiades; 5. black; 6. full of, क्रियाविशेषबहुलां भोगैश्वर्यगतिं प्रति Bg.ii.43; 7. accompanied by.
बहुला (I) f. 1. A cow; 2. the indigo piant; 3. cardamoms.
बहुला (II) f. pl. The Pleiades.
बाहुल (I) m. 1. Fire; 2. the lunar month Kārtīka.
बाहुल (II) n. 1. Manifoldness; 2. a mail for the arms.
बहुल-आलाप a. garrulous, loquacious.
बहुल-गंधा f. cardamoms.
बहुलिका f. pl. The Pleiades.
बाह m. 1. The arm; 2. a horse.
बाहा f. the arm.
बाहा-बाहवि ind. hand to hand, arm against arm. Cf. बाहूबाहवि.
बाहीक (I) m. pl. The people of the Punjab.
बाहीक (II) m. An inhabitant of the Panjab.
बाहु-उत्क्षेपम् ind. having raised the arms, बाहूत्क्षेपं क्रंदितुं च प्रवृत्ता Sak.v.
बाहु-कुंड, -कुब्ज a. crippled in the arins.
बाहु-कुंड, -कुब्ज a. crippled in the arins.
बाहु-कुंथ m. a wing (of a bird).
बाहु-चाप m. the distance measured by the extended arms.
बाहु-ज m. 1. a man of the Kṣatriya caste; See M.i.31; 2. a parrot.
बाहु-ज्या f. a sine (in math.).
बाहु-त्र m.n. vantbrass.
बाहु-त्राण n. vantbrass.
बाहु-दंड m. 1. a staff-like arm; 2. punishment with the arm.
बाहु-पाश m. 1. a particular attitude in fighting; 2. an embrace.
बाहु-प्रहरण n. boxing, wrestling.
बाहूबाहवि ind. hand to band, arm against arm.
बाहु-भूषा f. an ornament worn on the arm.
बाहु-भेदिन् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
बाहु-मूल n. 1. the armpit; 2. the shoulder-blade.
बाहु-युद्ध n. a personal encounter, pugilism.
बाहु-योध, -योधिन् m. a wrestler, a boxer.
बाहु-योध, -योधिन् m. a wrestler, a boxer.
बाहु-लता f. an arm like a creeper.
बाहु-लता˚अंतर n. the breast, the bosom.
बाहु-वीर्य n. strength of arm.
बाहु-व्यायाम m. athletic exercise.
बाहु-शालिन् m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. of Bhīma.
बाहु-शिखर n. the root of the shoulder.
बाहु-संभव m. a man of the Kṣatriya caste.
बाहु-सहस्रभृत् m. an epithet of king Kārtavīrya, killed by Paraśurāma.
बाहुगुण्य n. Possession of many excellences.
बाहुदंतक n. A treatise on moral philosophy said to be composed by Indra.
बाहुदंतेय m. An epithet of Indra.
बाहुदा f. Name of a river.
बाहुभाष्य n. Garrulity, loquaciousness.
बाहुरूप्य n. Manifoldness.
बाहुल-ग्रीव m. a peacock.
बाहुलक n. 1. Manifoldness; 2. a grammatical term implying the indeterminate applicability of a rule.
बाहुलेय m. An epithet of Kārtikeya.
बाहुल्य n. 1. Multiplicity, manifoldness; 2. abundance, plenty; 3. the common order of things.

बाह्य (I) a. (f. ह्या) 1. Situated without, outward, exterior, यस्य चोपवनं बाह्यं गंधवद्गंधमादनम् K.S.vi.46, बाह्योद्यानस्थितहरशिरश्चंद्रिकाधौतहर्म्या Megh.i.7; 2. external, R.viii.89, M.viii.25; 3. foreign, excluded, जातास्तदूर्वोरुपमानबाह्याः K.S.i.36.
बाह्य (II) m. 1. A foreigner; 2. one who is excommunicated.(बाह्यम्, बाह्येन and बाह्ये are used as indeclinables in the sense of ‘outside, on the outside.’)

बाह्य (I) a. (f. ह्या) 1. Situated without, outward, exterior, यस्य चोपवनं बाह्यं गंधवद्गंधमादनम् K.S.vi.46, बाह्योद्यानस्थितहरशिरश्चंद्रिकाधौतहर्म्या Megh.i.7; 2. external, R.viii.89, M.viii.25; 3. foreign, excluded, जातास्तदूर्वोरुपमानबाह्याः K.S.i.36.
बाह्वृच्य n. Traditional teaching of the Ṛgveda.
